idea: When to replace old plumbing pipes
title: Signs It Might Be Time for a Pipe Upgrade
description: If your home was built before the 1980s, your plumbing system might be due for a closer look. Older materials like galvanized steel or cast iron naturally degrade over time, leading to hidden issues. Keep an eye out for warning signs such as persistent low water pressure, discolored or rusty water, frequent pinhole leaks, or visible corrosion on exposed basement pipes. While small repairs can help in the short term, widespread pipe aging often requires a full or partial replacement to protect your property from water damage. Contact a licensed plumber to schedule an inspection and assess the condition of your pipes.
